digest.component_or_area: eval specs, eval solver, and gold-set testing
propositions: Eval spec files contain dual vocabulary (Acceptance Criteria and Success Criteria headings) that must be collapsed to single heading per rubric redesign
Eval solver fixture generator emits duplicate criterion text under both Acceptance Criteria and Success Criteria headings, which should be consolidated to one
Gold-set expectation strings reference 'success criteria' language that no longer exists in the updated rubric and must be updated to match collapsed vocabulary
Generated fixture descriptions must contain Acceptance Criteria heading exactly once with no Success Criteria heading present
Gold-set pass/fail tallies must remain unchanged after vocabulary-only edits to confirm no semantic test expectations shifted
Carve-outs in plan_review_T2.md, plan_review_verifier files, and dod_uncertifiable concept must be preserved as-is per epic amendments
